title: Demo is out! Try my Mongolian Invasion of Vietnam game on Steam
author: Ok-Pirate5732
selftext:
I posted a preview of my game a couple weeks ago and some people were asking if there was going to be a demo. It's out now! 

If you're interested you can check it out on the [100 Bodies in the Grass steam page](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357660/100_Bodies_in_the_Grass/)

The demo includes all 4 classes and the first 5 waves. You can play it alone, with bots, or with up to 3 steam friends. 

Many thanks in advance if you take the time to check it out, and of course, feedback is always welcome!

comments.author: No_Department_4114
comments.body:
Amazing work.

Did you use Claude or Codex at max effort? And may I know if you had to design rigged/animated characters/movements or used any recommended bundle from Fab or Unity?

Thanks

replies.author: Ok-Pirate5732
replies.body:
Fable Max effort during initial planning/architecture, this was before opus 5.5 and probably not necessary now 

Usually medium/high effort opus depending on the task

comments.author: BitBacked
comments.body: Nice. Kind of tired of Diablo clones with the same European medieval theme, this is a breath of fresh air.

replies.author: Ok-Pirate5732
replies.body:
Definitely a big part of why I'm making this! Vietnam specifically really is only in video games as meme farmers you blow up with napalm during the Vietnam War, and southeast Asia overall is basically a big vacuum. 

Lot of potential there, some really cool/unexplored settings and time periods

comments.author: LostRequirement4828
comments.body: how did you animate this so well?? you used meshy animations?

replies.author: Ok-Pirate5732
replies.body:
Nah I would say animations are the biggest weakness of any ai tool right now 

All the animations are from free or paid assets that I modified onto standardized skeleton based on mixamo
